title: Older Emergency Department Users and Short-term Adverse Events at the Index Visit
brief_summary: This study evaluates the difference between PRISMA-7 and ER2 tool. There are some differences between PRISMA-7 and ER2 tool. The differences consist in evaluation criteria that are used to perform the both surveys. We suppose that evaluation criteria of PRISMA-7 is not accurately enough to calculate the length of hospital stay and to predict the short-term outcomes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Being 75 years old and over
* Brought at Emergency on medical stretcher

Exclusion Criteria:

* Being less than 75 years old
* Never come at Emergency
study_population: In this study will be enrolled people who are 75 years and over, and who come at Emergency not only for medical reason but also for social.
